description: This PHP script handles the display and editing of user signature popups within the SuiteCRM application. It includes security checks, loads necessary dependencies, initializes a UserSignature object, manages request parameters for creating or duplicating signatures, and renders the signature editing interface using a template engine with WYSIWYG capabilities.

classes.name: UserSignature
classes.description: A class representing user signature data, providing methods for retrieval and possibly other signature-related operations.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a UserSignature record from the database based on a provided record ID.
